desc:
Game is for fun. Alot of dragon ball inspiration. Not too much hand holding though.

Train, transform and fight your way across the galaxy.

Build your power from the ground up. Raise your stats, draw talent cards, master new forms and unlock rare traits as your power level climbs.

Travel between planets like Earth, Vegeta and Namek, each with its own NPCs, quests, bosses and secrets. Train in gravity chambers and the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, take on missions and invasions, and gather the dragon balls to make a wish.

Join one of 8 factions, each with its own buffs and passives. Compete in events like Battle Royale, the Gauntlet, Team Deathmatch and Conquest for titles, rewards and event wins.

Up to 3 character slots, daily rewards, and AFK World to earn while you're away.

Like the game and follow the creator's page to use codes and get extra rewards. Check the Trello in the social links for the full guide.
